description:
## v1.1.0

### New patch
- **Hide broken installation dialog** (Opera & Opera Beta): Opera's modal "Your app installation appears to be broken. Try to uninstall and reinstall" is a crash-recovery nag, not a signature check — it also appears on unmodified installs after any startup crash, inside app-cloning tools (dual-space) and on ARM/x86 mismatches. The patch no-ops the dialog builder and forces the OperaApplication broken-installation flag to false so startup proceeds normally. Full chain documented in evidence/ANALYSIS.md §5.

### Improvements
- Memory: the string patches no longer materialize every class of the app as mutable (the documented patcher OOM antipattern). They now use the official matchAllMethodIndicesForEach pattern — measured peak patching RSS dropped from 1.1–1.5 GB to ~333 MB on Opera Beta base.apk.
- All patches verified headlessly against the real Opera Beta 104.0.5262.91143 base.apk (4/4 Opera/Beta patches succeed; the GX patch applies to GX bundles only).

### Patches
- **Disable ad modules** (Opera & Opera Beta): breaks the reflective class lookup for the bundled Liftoff/Vungle, Mintegral and Pangle/ByteDance ad SDK modules.
- **Remove sponsored Speed Dial** (Opera & Opera Beta): neutralizes the suggested-sites partner_data / partner_tree / domain_data queries, so sponsored tiles never load.
- **Disable Acceptable Ads whitelist** (Opera & Opera Beta): replaces the hidden pure-whitelist filter lists in assets/abp_files/op/ (Google/Yandex measurement, Taboola, gambling + affiliate DOCUMENT exceptions, AppsFlyer/Adjust/Kochava/CJ allows) with empty compiled lists.
- **Hide broken installation dialog** (Opera & Opera Beta): no-ops the crash-recovery nag described above.
- **Remove sponsored Speed Dial** (Opera GX): strips operagx.gg affiliate / realUrl partner entries from the preloaded start page.
